integrity: The coefficients are derived from the least-squares normal equations, the positivity defect is an exact linear-program calculation, and the global seven-point maximum is proved by exact finite verification through radius 27 plus a uniform analytic tail bound. The packaged exact-rational checker replays all finite identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns center smoothing on symmetric equally spaced windows for ordinary unweighted degree-two and degree-three Savitzky--Golay fits. It does not cover endpoint formulas, higher polynomial degrees, irregular grids, derivative filters, or stochastic error criteria. The full text of the closest 1983 pitfalls paper was unavailable through the lawful routes attempted, leaving a residual originality risk.
title: Seven points maximize the positivity defect of quadratic Savitzky–Golay smoothing
